items.evidence: python roll.py --headless --ticks N with --inputs / --script FILE, --board 1|2|3, --settings-dir DIR all ran as the README says and printed one JSON object with tick, screen, board, score, lives, ball, coins, crates, bridge_x, volume, language, selected, texts, sounds.
--frame out.png after headless runs (title, settings, boards 1-3, paused, won, lost): every file is a PNG whose IHDR says 800 x 480.

python roll.py --sound NAME f.wav (and sounds/*.wav, byte-identical): coin 0.30 s, bounce 0.18 s, fall 0.90 s, clear 0.90 s; peaks 19956/28146/5293/19323; different lengths, hashes and pitch (zero crossings 2457/311/1176/1739 per s).
tick 0: screen title, selected Start. menu_down -> Settings -> Quit -> Start (wraps); menu_up from Start -> Quit; '0 enter' -> screen play, board 1, score 0, lives 3.

Settings at first: 'Volume: 8', 'Language: English'. menu_right 9, menu_left 7, six rights stop at 10, twelve lefts stop at 0; left/right on Language switches to es ('Idioma: Español'); Enter on Back (and escape) returns to title.

With es: title [Roll, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir, 'Arriba / Abajo: mover   Enter: elegir'], settings [Ajustes, Volumen, Idioma, Volver, ...], play ['Tablero 1 de 3', 'Puntos: 0', 'Vidas: 3', 'W A S D o flechas: empujar   Esc: pausa'], paused [Pausa, Continuar, Salir al título], won [Ganaste, Puntos: 30, 'Pulsa Enter para volver al título'], lost [Fin del juego, ...]. Only the name Roll and the key names Enter/Esc/WASD stay as they are.
Run 1 with settings dir m07 set volume 5 and es (settings.json written); run 2 with the same dir starts with volume 5, language es and Spanish texts; a run without --settings-dir starts at 8, en.

Started by enter on the title: y first <= 0.3 at play tick 26 (0.2935), back above 0.3 at tick 30, peaks 0.506, 0.307, 0.265; at 600 ticks of play the ball is at y 0.25; sounds ['bounce','bounce','bounce'] (3).
Board 1, push from rest at tick 120 to 150: right -> x 0.51 at end, 1.46 30 ticks later, 2.06 50 ticks later; left -x, up -z, down +z alike (CLI at tick 200: x 2.065 / -2.065, z -2.065 / 2.065).

Steered board-1 script: each coin +10 with 'coin' and the coin gone from coins; at tick 591 the fourth coin: score 40, board 2, sounds ...'coin','clear', ball at (-3, 1.25, 0) i.e. board 2's start, board 2's three coins and six crates in the state.
--board 2, no input: every crate within 0.0 of (0, 0.25|0.75, -0.5|0|0.5) at every tick through 300 (and still at 600).

--board 2 '0 right' held: ball stops at x about -0.07 and never reaches x = 1 (85 ticks with the crates removed in memory); after 400 ticks crates moved 0.27/0.40/0.20/0.34/0.49/0.55 (three over 0.3), no crate with y < 0.2 over the board at any tick.
Steered board-2 script (judge-scratch/m13.txt): two crates rammed off the +z edge fall (y -4.86 at tick 1743) and at tick 1744 crates goes from 6 to 4; the four others remain where they were.
Same run, tick 1760: lives 3 -> 2, 'fall' appended, ball at (-3, 1.25, 0), coins unchanged (taken coin stays taken), crates identical. Board 1 fall then clearing board 1: board 2 starts with lives 2.

Script m16.txt puts the ball at rest on the bridge by tick 419; ticks 419-598 the ball-minus-bridge offset varies at most 0.19, y stays 0.25, no life lost. '120 right' (bridge near x = 2): ball enters the gap, y -4.74 at tick 255, life lost at 257 with 'fall'.

--board 3 with m17.txt (ends '480 right,535 none,550 left,590 none'): tick 564 screen won, score 30, coins [] (the x=1 coin was taken on the bridge). 300 more ticks with right/escape/menu_down/up: state identical; enter -> title.

--board 1 '0 right': third fall at tick 414 -> screen lost, lives 0; 200 more ticks with left/up/escape/menu_down give an identical state (score, ball, coins, crates); same on board 2; enter -> title.

Escape at tick 70 during the board-2 strike and at tick 100 on board 3: screen paused, Resume selected; 400 ticks later with pushes, ball/crates/bridge_x/score identical to just before escape; enter on Resume moves again; menu_down + enter (Quit to title) -> title.
Two runs of m13.txt on board 2 for 1800 ticks and two runs of '0 right,60 none' for 400 ticks print byte-identical JSON, crates included.

b2_start/b2_strike.png: perspective from above and in front (+z), whole 8x4 board, shaded patterned sphere at the state's x, crates as shaded boxes at the state's places, three coins. b3_090/b3_180.png: two slabs, gap, bridge drawn over x 0..2 and 1..3 as bridge_x says.

Frames title_es, settings_es, paused_es, won_es, lost_es show the Spanish texts (EMPEZAR, AJUSTES, VOLUMEN: 5, PAUSA, CONTINUAR, GANASTE, FIN DEL JUEGO, PUNTOS); play frames show 'BOARD 2 OF 3' / 'TABLERO 1 DE 3', score and lives.

audio.play returns at volume <= 0 and audio.wav_bytes multiplies samples by volume/10 (gui.py passes settings.volume); sounds still listed in the state. But see defects: the window plays no sound at any volume.
README says how to play, gives the headless, frame and --sound commands (all ran as written from another folder) and a file-by-file list.

defects: The window game never plays a sound: audio.play calls winsound.PlaySound with SND_MEMORY | SND_ASYNC, which raises RuntimeError 'Cannot play asynchronously from memory' (checked with a silent buffer); the except swallows it.

Crates pass into each other: after the board-2 strike ('0 right,60 none', 400 ticks) crates rest in pairs with centres about 0.06 apart at the same height, e.g. (0.134, 0.256, -0.471) and (0.189, 0.257, -0.493); such pairs then move and fall together.
A ball rolling fast into the gap on board 3 can be thrown back up by the bridge's side face (y 0.23 in the gap, then 0.63 on the bridge, then a 1.16 hop onto the second slab) instead of falling.
In the PNG font the letter V looks like W (LIWES, WOLUMEN, WIDAS).
